ko.title: 장음계
ko.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C D E F | G A B c |
```

온음·온음·반음·온음·온음·온음·반음으로 올라갑니다. C장조에서는 흰 건반만 사용합니다.

### 음의 순서를 따라가기

C–D–E–F–G–A–B–C에서 E–F와 B–C 사이만 반음이다. 피아노의 흰 건반 사이 간격이 모두 온음이라고 생각하면 이 두 곳을 놓친다. 시작음을 G로 바꾸어 같은 온음·반음 순서를 유지하려면 F 대신 F♯이 필요하다. 따라서 장음계의 기준은 흰 건반 여부보다 음 사이의 간격 순서다. 이 카드의 C장음계는 그 순서를 듣고 확인하기 쉬운 한 사례다.

### 들어 보기

반음이 있는 위치와 건너뛰는 간격을 찾아보세요. 마지막 음이 중심음으로 돌아오는 느낌도 들어 보세요.

en-US.title: Major scale
en-US.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C D E F | G A B c |
```

Ascending steps are whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. C major uses only the white keys.

### Following the pitch pattern

In C–D–E–F–G–A–B–C, only E–F and B–C are half steps. Assuming every gap between white keys is a whole step misses those two positions. Starting on G while preserving the same step pattern requires F-sharp instead of F. A major scale is therefore identified by its ordered intervals, not by the absence of black keys. This C example makes the pattern easy to inspect before considering the same structure from another starting pitch.

### Listen for

Listen for half steps and wider gaps, then notice the return to the tonal center.

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.
en-US.summary: A seven-note pattern of whole–whole–half–whole–whole–whole–half steps

ja.title: 長音階
ja.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C D E F | G A B c |
```

上行の間隔は全音・全音・半音・全音・全音・全音・半音です。ハ長調では白鍵だけを使います。

### 音の並びをたどる

C–D–E–F–G–A–B–Cでは、E–FとB–Cだけが半音である。白鍵の間をすべて全音と考えると、この二か所を見落とす。Gから同じ全音・半音の順序を保つにはFでなくF♯が必要になる。長音階を決めるのは白鍵かどうかではなく、音程の順序である。このCの例で構造を確かめ、別の開始音にも同じ原理を考えられる。

### 聴くポイント

半音の位置と広い間隔を探し、最後に中心音へ戻る響きも聴きましょう。

西洋記譜法と12平均律による学習用合成音の例です。実演の音色や強弱を再現するものではありません。
ja.summary: 全・全・半・全・全・全・半音の順に進む七音の構成

zh-TW.title: 大音階
zh-TW.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C D E F | G A B c |
```

上行間距依序為全、全、半、全、全、全、半音。C大調只使用白鍵。

### 跟著音高排列

C–D–E–F–G–A–B–C中，只有E–F與B–C是半音。若以為白鍵間全是全音，就會漏掉這兩處。改從G開始而保留相同間距順序，就需用F♯而非F。因此大音階由音程排列決定，不是由是否使用黑鍵決定。這個C範例方便先確認結構，再思考從其他音開始。

### 聆聽重點

聆聽半音與較大間距的位置，並注意最後回到中心音的感受。

這是使用西方記譜法與十二平均律的學習用合成音範例，不模擬現場演奏的音色或力度。
zh-TW.summary: 依全、全、半、全、全、全、半音順序排列的七音組成

en-US.title: Natural minor scale
en-US.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C D _E F | G _A _B c |
```

Compared with the parallel major scale, degrees 3, 6 and 7 are lowered. C natural minor shares notes with E-flat major, but has a different tonal center.

### Following the pitch pattern

Compared with C major, E, A and B become E-flat, A-flat and B-flat while the center C stays fixed. That is a parallel major–minor comparison. E-flat major instead shares the pitch collection but organizes it around a different center. The same inventory therefore need not mean the same tonal interpretation. Notice that the final B-flat–C step is a whole tone; the harmonic-minor card changes precisely that approach to C.

### Listen for

Listen for half steps and wider gaps, then notice the return to the tonal center.

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.
en-US.summary: A seven-note pattern lowering degrees 3, 6 and 7 of the major scale on the same tonic by a semitone

ja.title: 自然短音階
ja.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C D _E F | G _A _B c |
```

同主長調に比べ、第3・6・7音が半音低くなります。ハ自然短音階と変ホ長音階は構成音が同じでも中心音が異なります。

### 音の並びをたどる

C長音階と比べるとE・A・BがE♭・A♭・B♭になり、中心のCは保たれる。これは同じ主音の長短を比べている。一方、E♭長音階とは音の集合が同じでも中心が異なる。同じ音一覧だから同じ調性とは限らない。最後のB♭–Cは全音であり、和声的短音階ではこのCへの近づき方が変わる。

### 聴くポイント

半音の位置と広い間隔を探し、最後に中心音へ戻る響きも聴きましょう。

西洋記譜法と12平均律による学習用合成音の例です。実演の音色や強弱を再現するものではありません。
ja.summary: 同じ主音の長音階より第3・6・7音が半音低い七音の構成

zh-TW.title: 自然小音階
zh-TW.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C D _E F | G _A _B c |
```

相對於同主音大音階，第3、6、7級降低半音。C自然小音階與E♭大音階共用音高，但主音不同。

### 跟著音高排列

與C大音階比較，E、A、B改成E♭、A♭、B♭，中心C不變，這是同主音大小調的比較。E♭大音階則共享音集合，但中心不同，因此音清單相同不代表調性解讀相同。最後B♭–C是全音；和聲小音階會改變這段接近C的方式。

### 聆聽重點

聆聽半音與較大間距的位置，並注意最後回到中心音的感受。

這是使用西方記譜法與十二平均律的學習用合成音範例，不模擬現場演奏的音色或力度。
zh-TW.summary: 比同主音大音階的第三、六、七音各低半音的七音組成

ko.description:
```abc

M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C D _E F | G _A B c |
```

자연단음계의 7번째 음을 반음 올립니다. 6번째와 7번째 음 사이의 증2도와 마지막 반음 진행을 비교하세요.

### 음의 순서를 따라가기

자연단음계의 B♭만 B로 올리면 마지막 B–C가 반음으로 좁아진다. 동시에 앞의 A♭–B는 3반음으로 넓어지므로 음 하나를 바꾸어도 이웃한 두 간격이 함께 달라진다. A에서 B까지 두 음이름을 쓰므로 이 3반음은 단3도가 아니라 증2도다. 악보를 보며 넓어진 곳과 좁아진 곳을 차례로 들어 보면 이름뿐 아니라 음계의 구조 변화도 이해할 수 있다.

en-US.title: Harmonic minor scale
en-US.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C D _E F | G _A B c |
```

Raise degree 7 of natural minor. Compare the augmented second between degrees 6 and 7 with the final half step to the tonic.

### Following the pitch pattern

Raising only B-flat to B narrows the final B–C step to a semitone. At the same time, A-flat–B widens to three semitones: changing one note affects both neighboring gaps. Since the letter names run from A to B, that three-semitone interval is an augmented second rather than a minor third. Listen for the widened gap followed by the narrow approach to C while following the written notes, connecting the name with the structural change.

### Listen for

Listen for half steps and wider gaps, then notice the return to the tonal center.

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.
en-US.summary: A form raising natural minor’s seventh degree a semitone, creating an augmented second between degrees 6 and 7

ja.title: 和声的短音階
ja.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C D _E F | G _A B c |
```

自然短音階の第7音を半音上げます。第6音と第7音の増2度と、主音へ進む最後の半音を比べましょう。

### 音の並びをたどる

自然短音階のB♭だけをBに上げると、最後のB–Cは半音になる。同時にA♭–Bが3半音へ広がるため、一音の変更が隣接する二つの間隔を変える。音名がAからBなので、この3半音は短3度でなく増2度である。譜面を追いながら広い間隔とCへ近づく狭い間隔を続けて聴くと、名称と構造の変化がつながる。

### 聴くポイント

半音の位置と広い間隔を探し、最後に中心音へ戻る響きも聴きましょう。

西洋記譜法と12平均律による学習用合成音の例です。実演の音色や強弱を再現するものではありません。
ja.summary: 自然短音階の第7音を半音上げ、第6・7音間が増2度になる構成

zh-TW.title: 和聲小音階
zh-TW.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C D _E F | G _A B c |
```

將自然小音階的第7級升高半音。比較第6至7級的增二度與最後通往主音的半音。

### 跟著音高排列

只把自然小音階的B♭升成B，最後B–C就縮成半音；同時A♭–B擴成3半音，可見改一音會影響兩側間距。字母音名由A到B，因此這3半音叫增二度，不是小三度。看著譜先聽變寬的間隔，再聽接近C的窄間隔，就能把名稱連到結構變化。

### 聆聽重點

聆聽半音與較大間距的位置，並注意最後回到中心音的感受。

這是使用西方記譜法與十二平均律的學習用合成音範例，不模擬現場演奏的音色或力度。
zh-TW.summary: 將自然小音階第七音升高半音，使第六、七音間成為增二度的組成

en-US.description:
```abc

M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C ^C D ^D | E F ^F G | ^G A ^A B | c4 |
```

Every adjacent pair is one semitone apart. This ascent is spelled with sharps; flats may be appropriate in other contexts.

### Following the pitch pattern

Twelve semitone steps take C to the next C. Counting both endpoints gives thirteen sounded notes but only twelve pitch classes within the octave. E–F and B–C already span semitones, so no black key is needed between them. This ascent uses sharp spellings as a notation example. Reaching the same key on an equal-tempered keyboard does not make every enharmonic spelling equally appropriate in every harmonic or melodic context.

### Listen for

Listen for half steps and wider gaps, then notice the return to the tonal center.

en-US.title: Whole-tone scale
en-US.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C D E ^F | ^G ^A c2 |
```

All adjacent notes are a whole tone apart. There are six distinct pitch classes; the final C repeats the starting pitch an octave higher.

### Following the pitch pattern

The example rises C–D–E–F-sharp–G-sharp–A-sharp–C with six equal two-semitone gaps. Since 6×2=12, six distinct pitch classes lead back to C at the octave. Unlike the major scale, no two locations narrow into half steps. Listen for the repeated equal relationship rather than searching for a special half-step approach. That symmetry describes the collection; it does not by itself dictate the tonal center or mood of every piece that uses it.

### Listen for

Listen for half steps and wider gaps, then notice the return to the tonal center.

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.
